summary:
Lyft is the ride-hailing company at lyft.com. The pink mark in the tab is the favicon ride bookmarks request from that host.

Checked 12 November 2026 against lyft.com. HTML came from https://www.lyft.com/ (HTTP 200). No icon link tags were readable in the HTML. Files below came from a manifest or from a path that returned an image.

A request to the favicon.ico URL https://lyft.com/favicon.ico returned png (150×150, 1939 bytes), not an ICO container. Formats that saved: png.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

Brand colour #ff00bb comes from the most common non-white pixel in png-150x150-01.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: png-150x150-01.png at 150×150 (png, 1939 bytes) from https://lyft.com/favicon.ico.
